evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Intensity and affective impact of own emotions
criteria.definition: Vivid, affecting own feelings and emotional highs/lows versus seldom becoming emotional or affected.
criteria.high_evidence: Experiences own feelings intensely, is emotionally affected, or has substantial emotional highs/lows.
criteria.low_evidence: Seldom gets emotional, is little affected by feelings, or experiences few emotional highs/lows.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Not inherently negative mood, instability diagnosis or inability to cope. Calm control can coexist with intense experience; ordinary happiness alone does not establish intensity.

criteria.label: Resonance with and understanding of others emotions
criteria.definition: Feeling others emotions and understanding emotional people.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels emotional resonance with others or understands their becoming emotional.
criteria.low_evidence: Rarely resonates with others feelings or does not understand emotional people.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. A6 sympathy/helping alone is not shared emotional experience. Cognitive understanding can differ from resonance; preserve explicit opposing subcontents as mixed rather than duplicate grades.

criteria.label: Passion about causes
criteria.definition: Emotional passion about causes rather than merely holding a position.
criteria.high_evidence: Has emotionally passionate investment in a cause.
criteria.low_evidence: Supports or considers causes without passion or emotional engagement.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Political position O6, volunteering A3 and effort C4 alone are insufficient. No specific ideology or publicly admirable cause required.

criteria.label: Enjoyment of self-examination and self-understanding
criteria.definition: Enjoying examination of own life and trying to understand oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: Enjoys self-reflection or actively tries to understand own experience and motives.
criteria.low_evidence: Has little interest in examining life or understanding self.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. O1 reflection/O5 analysis overlap retained. Actual success of insight is not required, and repetitive distress alone is not enjoyment or an attempt to understand.

criteria.label: Awareness of own emotional reactions
criteria.definition: Noticing own affective reactions versus rarely noticing them.
criteria.high_evidence: Registers and notices feelings as they occur.
criteria.low_evidence: Own emotional reactions tend to pass unnoticed.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Awareness is not intensity: a faint noticed feeling counts here, not automatically C1. Lack of a feeling is not lack of noticing an existing feeling.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent unfavorable portrayed behavior is not actual experimental instruction failure or severe incoherence.
External constraint or imposed role alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence can coexist.
O3 centers own emotional sensitivity, impact, awareness and self-understanding, while retaining others resonance and causes. It is not merely A6 compassion, E6 cheerfulness or N6 overwhelm.
Do not replace target evidence with moral worth, politeness, helpfulness or verbosity.
